subject: E4.1 v1-dependency F1 — RULED s345: leading-`package X;` evals lower AS section X via D1-lite QUALIFIED emission
description:
DONE s346b (gen v2-107), per the s345 ruling §2.

THE ROUTE (subtraction, not addition): stop CONSUMING the leading `package X;` at segment level, so it reaches _lower_block's D1-lite nested-package path — which pushes X onto the Environment while the SECTION package stays the eval's root.  That is exactly the `current ne cur_pkg` condition _sub_name_for_emission and _lower_our_decl's qualify branch already key on, so the QUALIFIED emission the ruling asked for happens with no new mechanism.

Three supporting facts, each fed to an EXISTING mechanism:
 1. skip the segment-level sub extraction for that segment — it runs BEFORE lowering, so it would name the subs unqualified (the s342g silent-wrong: `pl-f` read in :pcl while the caller looks up X::pl-f).  Left in the statement stream they hoist through _sub_name_for_emission.
 2. the package ENTER forms lead the eval BODY, ahead of the defs/sched interleave — a `use` lowers into sched (emitted first), so `use Role::Tiny` ran in main and its import recorded the wrong package (Role-Tiny create-hook.t: got 'main').
 3. that `use` gets `:into "X"` — the eval body is READ in :pcl and p-use takes its target from *package*.  v1 already emits :into for the same reader-vs-Perl split inside a do/eval block, so the seam supplies the two facts that branch keys on (_seam_outer_pkg, _block_depth).

ACCEPTANCE: all five ruling probes + the s342g inverse guard pass with ZERO v1 routes (X::f + X->f work while main->can('f') is false; our $V=7 -> $X::V; bless+method dispatch; __PACKAGE__ is X; caller-lexical capture survives).  Board F1 events 18 -> 0.  Gate 131/4640; corpus-diff identical across 111 files; sweep 0 new / 0 fixed / 0 LOST.  Board vs s343: 3 files differ — role-basic-exceptions 2->4 ok, reduce.t (from #78), and role-basic-composition PASS(8 ok) -> PARTIAL(10 ok/3 not-ok) because it now runs 13 rows where it ran 8 (more coverage AND more passes; the label is the board's zero-not-ok rule).

REFUSED, not shipped wrong: an `our` declared in the region and read back UNQUALIFIED — task #240 (measurement + rejected rename approach recorded there).  The multi-switch shape stays refused (zero measured events) and its text KEEPS the `Parser2 TODO:` prefix on purpose — parse_with_fallback keys the v1 retry on /^Parser2\b/, so the perl-shaped rephrase belongs to the E4.1 step-2 flip commit (§5a.3).

Guards: Pl/t/parser2-02.t, seven rows (no gate; sub defined qualified + NOT bare; enter precedes `use`; :into "X"; the #240 residue still refused; multi-switch still refused).
